name: cell-run-history
description: JupyterLab-style 'Last executed at … in …' status for notebook cells, with the last runs on hover.

cellRunHistory.maxRuns.description: Number of runs kept and shown per notebook cell.

cellRunHistory.recordTiming.description: Save the timing of each run in the cell metadata (same format as JupyterLab's execute-time extension), so the last run is shown when the notebook is reopened in VS Code or JupyterLab.
